name: Spicy Impala 38
author: KhelVers
description: Gradient rounded white form that changes colour on hover.
howItWorks:
On hover, bottom becomes 3px, background changes from linear-gradient(144deg,#af40ff,
              #5b42f3 50%,#00ddeb) to linear-gradient(144deg,#9706ff,
              #2f0fff 50%,#18f0ff). On focus, the outline is removed, background changes from linear-gradient(144deg,#af40ff,
              #5b42f3 50%,#00ddeb) to #f1f1f1.
